solutions.title: Cubic enumeration with set deduplication
solutions.strategy: Try every triple, sort matching values inside the triple, and use a set to remove duplicates.

timeComplexity.explanation: All index triples can be examined.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The set stores k unique answer triplets.

solutions.title: Sort plus two pointers
solutions.strategy: Sort once, fix each first value, then use a two-pointer scan to find matching pairs while skipping duplicates.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each fixed first value runs one linear two-pointer scan after sorting.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output stores k triplets; sorting may use auxiliary runtime memory.
